doc.description: Fast controller for MAV group 12 (cmjong). Receives color detection and optical flow obstacle flags, and navigates using a state machine: SAFE_AND_WAIT, TURN_AVOID, MOVE_FORWARD_WITH_FIXED_DISTANCE, OUT_OF_BOUNDS.
